signal: Merge launched its Agent Handler in October 2025, exposing governed tools to AI agents over MCP across 220+ integrations.

email.body1:
Jamie, saw Merge shipped the Agent Handler, exposing governed tools to AI agents over MCP across 220-plus integrations.

As the platform leans agentic, the RevOps bottleneck usually moves to signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface but nobody acts fast enough. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so signals turn into booked meetings with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Merge off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jamie, quick follow-up for Merge.

In most RevOps stacks the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting is where the measurable lift hides. Tighten that loop and reply rates move before you change anything else about the team or the data.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70 percent, and I'll show where Merge's gaps likely sit.
email.body3:
Jamie, last bit of proof for Merge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Merge's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jamie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't on the roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping agentic infrastructure is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Merge either way.
